Private Function Settings(ByVal ws As Worksheet) As String
    Dim s As String, v As Variant, i As Long
    On Error Resume Next
    s = "F=" & ws.ConsolidationFunction
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then s = "F=E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
    v = ws.ConsolidationOptions
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & " O=E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        s = s & " O=" & TypeName(v) & "(" & LBound(v) & ")"
        For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v): s = s & "," & TypeName(v(i)) & ":" & CStr(v(i)): Next
    Else
        s = s & " O=" & TypeName(v)
    End If
    v = ws.ConsolidationSources
    If Err.Number <> 0 Then
        s = s & " S=E" & Err.Number: Err.Clear
    ElseIf IsArray(v) Then
        s = s & " S=" & TypeName(v) & "(" & LBound(v) & ")"
        For i = LBound(v) To UBound(v): s = s & "," & CStr(v(i)): Next
    Else
        s = s & " S=" & TypeName(v)
    End If
    Settings = s
End Function

Private Function Tried(ByVal which As Long) As String

    Case 11

    Case 12

    Case 13

    Case 14

    Case 65

    Case 71

    Case 74

    Case 75

    Case 76

    End Select
    For Each c In s3.Range("A1:F8")
        If Not IsEmpty(c.Formula) And c.Formula <> "" Then s = s & ";" & c.Address(False, False) & "=" & c.Formula & IIf(c.NumberFormat = "General", "", "{" & c.NumberFormat & "}")
    Next
    Tried = Mid(s, 2) & " | " & Settings(s3) & " | " & Settings(s1)
Done:
    wb.Close False
    Exit Function
Failed:
    Tried = "Err " & Err.Number & " " & Err.Description & " | " & Settings(s3)
    Resume Done
End Function

Public Function Probe(ByVal first As Long, ByVal last As Long) As String
    Dim s As String, i As Long
    Application.DisplayAlerts = False
    For i = first To last
        s = s & "@@@" & Tried(i)
    Next
    Application.DisplayAlerts = True
    Probe = Mid(s, 4)
End Function
